We can approve after you switch to median latency and add a short note (in parentheses) that P95 spikes are higher under full-load shots. Also please remove the third-party vendor name in paragraph 4 — we prefer not to call them out.

I'll loop ProductOps if they want to confirm the metrics (cc'ing ops@vantage-data.com).

Ellie
